description:
We are looking for **02 nurses** with at least one year of experience to work at our medical centers in **Kampala** and **Jinja**.

## About the role

The successful candidates will join our medical centers in Kampala and Jinja to support day-to-day patient care. We are looking for hardworking and compassionate nurses who are ready to serve our patients.

## Qualifications and requirements

- Certificate or diploma in nursing
- At least one year of nursing experience
- Ready to work in Kampala or Jinja

## What we offer

- Salary is negotiable

## How to apply

For more information and discussion, call or inbox **+256 772 410 875**.

Thank you.
